_about: Names players use for places on the maps, for `zones find` (core/places.py). synonyms: other words the game's files use for a word (transliterated Russian, or another word). places: a place's name and other names (aka), its map (as zone files name maps), where it is (at: x, z; optional), the objects anchoring it in the game's files (objects: an object name, or part of one, looked up in the imported map; optional) and a note. Add a place once it has been checked against the game, and say in its note how.

places.name: White Knight
places.note: Repair block on the east side of the vehicle yard (PTOR). 1F (-6.8 m): BMP-2 hangar and offices; 2F (about -4 m, east wing, not on the floor map); 3F (-0.95 m): north offices and the hangar roof; roof at 2.3 m. Checked against the game's white_horse marker and knight signs, and the Reserve map on maps.tmubl.com.

places.name: Black Knight
places.note: Repair block on the west side of the vehicle yard (PTOR), across from the White Knight: storeys at -6.8, -3.95 and -0.95 m. Checked against the game's black_horse marker and knight signs, and the Reserve map on maps.tmubl.com.

places.name: White Pawn
places.note: Barracks (Base_Casarms). Where the game's white_pawn marker is (under the building), not its middle: use `zones building` there.
